description.narrative: Increased access to water and sanitation services

:Number of persons provided with access to an improved drinking water source. Results are based on the number of water points built/rehabilitated multiplied by the number of beneficiaries per water point (e.g. tap, water plant, etc defined per project). For additional clarity, for projects which are connected to a water distribution network, an estimate will be made as to how many people connected to that network are beneficiaries of the project. To the extent possible, results will be disaggregated by income levels, gender and residence (urban/rural).

title.narrative: Increased access to water and sanitation services

description.narrative: Increased access to water and sanitation services

Number of persons provided with access to an improved sanitation facility. Results are based on the number of sanitation facilities constructed, rehabilitated or improved multiplied by the number of beneficiaries per facility. In principle this indicator applies only to sanitation facilities built directly for the use of municipal or rural communities. Industrial sanitation facilities will not contribute to this indicator unless they are also directly providing sanitation services for the benefit of local or other communities. For additional clarity, for projects which are connected to a sewerage network, an estimate will be made as to how many people connected to that network are beneficiaries of the project. To the extent possible, results will be disaggregated by income levels, gender and residence (urban/rural).
